entries.message: Feature - Make full-series watch sync reliable
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Make full-series watch sync reliable
Feature: Mark complete shows watched across seasons with the selected watch date and visible per-episode progress
Feature: Update open detail, dashboard, and Up Next views from live watch-state events without full-page rerenders
Feature: Finish local media-server writes before draining a paced, retrying Trakt queue, keep remove/add pairs atomic, and stop queued items on cancellation
Feature: Improve sync issue matching, retry coverage, and status feedback for failed episode destinations
Feature: Polish onboarding and login presentation, theme-aware branding, version metadata, and public release documentation
